title: Mary Anderson
html_source: Ulster Hall, Belfast, 16 June 1904, advertised a visit of “the World-Renowned Actress, Miss Mary Anderson (Madame de Marano) in the Balcony Scene from ‘Romeo and Juliet,’ etc. etc.” Other “eminent and celebrated artists” (vocal and instrumental, including Clyde Twelvetrees, cellist) were also to appear.
